review_method: Single visual review of rendered first-copy pages. This locates evidence and records legibility; it is not an independent sign-by-sign transcription.

objects.observation: A carries a clearly outlined multi-sign text; B carries a large long-eared animal with vegetation. Excavation DK151 is visible on A. These corroborate an inscription/hare-like-motif pairing on one object.
objects.limit: Seven W codes are retained from the export, not independently authenticated as exact code identities by the photograph.
objects.bridge_status: motif-side pairing located; not a complete authenticated bridge

objects.observation: A text and B large U-like composite are visible. The internal and upper details of B are less clear than the reconstructed type figure.

overall: No complete text-to-singleton-to-animal bridge has been independently authenticated from both artifact photographs in this review. Published reconstructed-type evidence and literal secondary-data matches remain separate.
